verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents several official MCP servers. A hosted search MCP server lets Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT search and retrieve site content. An admin MCP server gives AI tools write access to edit pages, update settings, and open PRs. A read-only Mintlify Index MCP server is also documented. The pricing page lists the MCP server as a platform feature, and a probe confirmed the official MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent and using these servers in practice.
